header: Configure Revocation Status Verification of Certificates
content:
The firewall and Panorama use certificates to authenticate users and devices for such applications
as Authentication Portal, GlobalProtect, site-to-site IPSec VPN, and web interface access to the
firewall/Panorama. To improve security, it is a best practice to configure the firewall or Panorama
to verify the revocation status of certificates that it uses for device/user authentication.
STEP 1 |
Configure a Certificate Profile for each application.
Assign one or more root CA certificates to the profile and select how the firewall verifies
certificate revocation status.
For details on the certificates that various applications use, see Keys and Certificates
STEP 2 |
Assign the certificate profiles to the relevant applications.
The steps to assign a certificate profile depend on the application that requires it.

hierarchy.parent: Set Up Verification for Certificate Revocation Status
